craft_notes: Sthāyin: mudrā-vidhi unit 11. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 10. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Staff-shaped but him should lead until three cavities; having held there, that quickly should drive with three cavities but.
l4.sanskrit_cite: daṇḍākāraṃ tu taṃ tāvannayedyāvatkakhatrayam nigṛhya tatra tattūrṇaṃ prerayet khatrayeṇa tu
